name: np_siren_wail
character: A police siren in wail: a slow sweep between 600 and 1400 Hz at 20 cycles a minute, harmonics to six, the first cruiser; it moves round the car (Doppler from its path) and is muffled behind the corner building.
note: 600-1400 Hz sits inside the 500-1800 Hz band reported for SAE J1849; 20 cycles a minute is the NIJ example for a wail. The pitch is dropped a little in the slow motion. ESTIMATE: the exact J1849 tables were not read; the sweep limits, six harmonics and the levels are starting values
